pr_title: Remove validation to stat call for symlinks since is a breaking change
pr_body:
Subsequently, remove the symlink cache logic as is no longer needed.
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/57221

cc @danmoseley

This apparently means stat/lstat is returning EINVAL. 

That's not listed in the man pages: 
https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/System/Conceptual/ManPages_iPhoneOS/man2/stat.2.html (says it's for macOS despite the URL)
https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/System/Conceptual/ManPages_iPhoneOS/man2/lstat.2.html
Thanks, I wonder why it only fails in macOS, same code runs in Linux distros without issues.

review_comments: These tests were validating that we throw when a self-referencing symlink is found in the recursion, while that is true for windows, that wasn't the case for Unix in 5.0, and it was going to be a breaking change caused by the same validation that I'm removing, so I updated the tests to ensure what is expected matches with 5.0
